decision.reason: Clock has the strongest trajectory-level validation by a wide margin, and three distinct interventions produced low forecast error. Memory-clock and history-all are worse; residual lag correlation leaves some uncertainty.
decision.prediction: After input ends, oscillations will remain aligned by elapsed time across interventions rather than reset to the timing of the last pulse.

mapping.target_relation: Shared elapsed-time periodic forcing is consistent with oscillations recurring across differently driven trajectories.
mapping.condition_to_check: A reproducible phase shift tied to input timing rather than elapsed time would weaken the clock explanation.
